Maya R.: Heads-up: we need to finalize the QBR slate and MDF breakdown for the joint marketplace + HW announcement. I pushed a revised alloc view to the board: https://tiny.redwood/partner-alloc-q3. Please review.
Owen K.: Quick clarification: are MDF pilots and marketplace co-marketing separate pots? I want to ensure we don't double-request creative spend.
Maya R.: Yes separate. MDF covers partner enablement and pilot incentives; marketplace co-marketing is handled from the marketplace launch budget. We'll cross-check to avoid overlap.
Priya S.: Finance input: every MDF disbursement over $10k requires a partner scorecard update and an ROI hypothesis in the doc. We can fast-track under $10k.
Dylan T.: For SI integrations: recommend requiring a short integration test with a dummy workload to validate KV cache behavior. That caught 2 regressions last quarter.
Maya R.: Good call — add to onboarding checklist. Also we need pledge windows for partner tiers: platinum gets priority QBR slot + 1x dedicated capacity ramp, gold gets marketing co-sell support.
Owen K.: Can we carve out a small HW credit reserve for marketplace partners to demo in the showroom? say $15k in credits.
Priya S.: We can if we move $15k from contingency. Need sign-off from partnerships lead.
Maya R.: I'll propose it in the ops meeting. Action owners: Priya will update the scorecard requirements doc, Dylan will add the KV cache integration test step, Owen will draft the showroom credit ask. I'll update the QBR slate by EOD.
partners-bot: Reminder: submit nominations for partner QBR by COB Friday.
Owen K.: FYI I'll tag two SIs for the nominations.
Maya R.: Thanks team — let's aim to freeze budgets by next Tue so marketing can schedule creative.
